title: Juicy British Lamb Roast
description: A traditional British-inspired lamb roast with a focus on keto-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a special occasion or holiday meal.
instructions: Rinse the lamb roast and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the lamb roast with salt, pepper, and chopped rosemary.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb roast until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the lamb roast to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Let the lamb roast rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with roasted vegetables, such as Brussels sprouts or asparagus, for a delicious keto meal.
